Alex: morning — quick async standup
Alex: what I did: adjusted latency SLO thresholds for /generate to 700ms and ran a small canary across eu-west.
Maya: saw canary traces, latency improved but error rate nudged up ~0.4% on tail.
Jamal: oncall update: handled pager at 03:12 — prometheus exporter on g0-rt3 OOMed and dropped metrics.
Jamal: restarted exporter, metrics resumed. filing INC-412 to track root cause and memory leak suspicion.
Pat: pushed alert-tuning PR: `alerts/latency_thresholds.yaml` — @Maya can you take a quick look? small delta change.
Maya: will review after this thread, can comment inline.
Alex: blocker: still seeing KV cache eviction causing tail latency spikes for long-context jobs, couldn't reproduce locally.
Li: I can help repro. can you drop a failing trace id or a short reproduction script? @Alex
Alex: trace link: https://traces.internal/9f8a - and here's the prometheus query I ran to compare canary vs prod:
```
sum(rate(llm_inference_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)
```
Maya: noticed an alert flapping on high-cardinality labels (model_id + shard). thinking of changing the alert to `topk(10, ...)` and adding a noise-suppression window.
Pat: good call. I'll add a runbook section for that alert and include mitigation steps (silence, inspect top labels, escalate).
sre-bot: deploy completed: infra/alerting v2.3 -> prod (deployer@ci) :white_check_mark:
Jamal: action items recap:
  1) @Pat create runbook PR for label-flap alert and link to INC-412
  2) @Maya review latency PR (alerts/latency_thresholds.yaml)
  3) @Li help Alex repro KV eviction on a debug node
  4) I'll attach logs from g0-rt3 and update the incident tracker
Pat: noted — will open PR by EOD and add playbook steps.
Maya: started review, will post comments in the PR thread.
Li: spinning up a debug node now and will run the canary workload (approx 20m). posting results here.
Alex: thanks all — I'll update the SLO dashboard with canary numbers and follow up with a short postmortem if KV eviction reproduces.
Maya: :thumbsup:
